versions.changelog:
video-call-agent 1.0.0

- Initial release: Start video calls with a real-time AI avatar using the Runway Characters API.
- Agent sends users a call invite link for standups, alerts, or check-ins.
- Customizable avatar with support for user-provided images and personalities.
- Full call transcript available for agent actions after call ends.
- Detailed privacy and setup instructions included for secure and flexible use.
